jobs.description: As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space. AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure. Key job responsibilities Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems. Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems. Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs. Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers. Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers. Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers. Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors. Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers. Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements. Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support. Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems. Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures. Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities. Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning. Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology. Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks. Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review. Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses. Perform other tasks as assigned by manager. A day in the life As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. jobs.description: As AI agents become the primary interface for advertisers and partners on Amazon Ads, we are building agent-native identity and authorization infrastructure that treats AI agents as first-class participants. We believe every agent should have a unique identity, authenticate through purpose-built flows, receive only the permissions its declared purpose requires, and produce a complete audit trail of every action it takes. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define and drive the product strategy for Agent Identity and Authorization Infrastructure within Amazon Ads. You will own the roadmap for how 5,000+ partners and 2M+ advertisers grant, scope, and govern AI agent access to their advertising accounts — spanning agent registry, authentication, capability-scoped authorization, advertiser-facing controls, and auditability. This is a greenfield opportunity to define the trust layer for agentic commerce at Amazon scale. Key job responsibilities - Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for agent identity, authentication, and authorization — from 1P agent registry through 3P developer SDK and advertiser-facing access controls - Define product requirements for capability-scoped authorization models that go beyond tool-level access to intent-bound, time-bound, and data-bound delegation - Drive cross-functional alignment across 10+ engineering teams, API platform, security, and partner-facing organizations to deliver integrated agent trust infrastructure - Author PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical specifications for new authorization primitives (agent-to-agent delegation, programmable delegation tokens, spend controls, circuit breakers) - Define and track success metrics including agent adoption, authorization accuracy, advertiser control adoption, and developer onboarding time - Represent advertiser and partner needs in executive-level prioritization, translating complex authorization concepts into clear customer value propositions - Partner with engineering to make build/buy/integrate decisions on authentication protocols (M2M auth, short-lived tokens, OAuth extensions for agents) - Drive beta programs with external partners (agencies, integrators) to validate product-market fit before scaled rollout A day in the life You'll start your day reviewing agent adoption metrics and authorization error rates across 1P and 3P surfaces. You might spend the morning in a design review with engineers debating whether capability-scoped permissions should be enforced at the gateway or service layer. After lunch, you're leading a working session with a large agency partner (like PacVue or Teikametrics) to understand how they want to register and manage multiple specialized agents under their application. In the afternoon, you're writing the product spec for the advertiser-facing Agent Access UI — where advertisers see every authorized agent, scope what each can do, and revoke access instantly. You close the day aligning with your VP on the 3P agent sandbox launch timeline for unBoxed. Your internal stakeholders include engineering (Identity, Authorization, Data, and Access Experience teams), the Ads Agent Orchestrator team, Developer Experience (DX), and Partner Enablement. Your customers are advertisers who need control over AI agents accessing their accounts, partners building agentic integrations, and internal 1P agent teams shipping skills on the Ads Agent platform. About the team The Ads Agent Identity and Authorization Infrastructure (AI²) team owns identity and access management for Amazon Ads — for both humans and AI agents. We manage registration, account management, permission controls, and ad-product eligibility that serve as gateways to Amazon Ads, impacting 5K+ partners and 2M+ advertisers globally with 800K+ registrations per year and 5M+ active users. We are a team of builders who ship at high velocity — we launched agent registry and agent authorization for 1P agents in Q1 2026, and are now extending to 3P. We value customer obsession (advertisers must trust the agents acting on their behalf), ownership (you own the product end-to-end from vision through metrics), and bias for action (we ship iteratively with real partners, not in isolation). We are based in New York (JFK19).

회사 소개

쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.

쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.

대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.

보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.

New Fintech Product 조직

쿠팡의 핀테크 조직은 고객의 쇼핑 경험을 넘어서는 새로운 금융 서비스를 제공하기 위해 끊임없이 혁신하고 있습니다. 이번에 새롭게 런칭할 New Fintech Product는 쿠팡 생태계 내에서 고객의 금융 생활을 혁신할 수 있는 핵심 제품으로, 결제, 자산관리, 금융 접근성 향상 등 다양한 영역에서 새로운 가치를 창출할 예정입니다. 이 제품은 초기 기획부터 개발, 런칭, 확장까지 전 과정을 함께할 핵심 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

THE ROLE

우리는 New Product 개발 경험과 대규모 프로젝트 리딩 경험을 갖춘 숙련된 Product Manager를 찾고 있습니다. 이 역할은 쿠팡의 새로운 핀테크 제품을 처음부터 정의하고, 고객 중심의 혁신적인 금융 경험을 만들어가는 데 핵심적인 역할을 하게 됩니다.

주요 책임

• 쿠팡의 New Fintech Product에 대한 Product 비전 및 전략 수립
• 0에서 1까지의 제품 개발 및 성공적인 런칭 주도
• 수백만 고객을 대상으로 하는 대규모 프로젝트 리딩 및 실행
• 고객의 금융 니즈를 반영한 혁신적인 기능 설계 및 구현
• 실험, 고객 피드백, 데이터 분석을 통해 지속적인 제품 개선
• 디자인, 엔지니어링, 리스크, 운영 등 다양한 팀과 협업하여 제품 로드맵 실행
• 글로벌 확장을 고려한 제품 전략 수립 및 현지화 기능 개발
• Product Manager 팀을 구축하고 리드하며, 조직 내외부에 제품 비전 전파

경험 및 자격

• 7년 이상의 Product Management 경험

• 마켓플레이스/소비자 플랫폼 모델의 복잡성 이해 – 선호

특성 및 역량

• 빠른 속도, 데이터 중심, 모호한 환경에서의 실행력

• 다양한 데이터를 분석하여 인사이트 도출 및 문제 해결
• 임원 및 다양한 이해관계자와의 효과적인 커뮤니케이션 능력

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고 사항
